reasons: Cited Section 16.9 text selects New York substantive law and requires actions to be commenced in a court sited within the State of New York, matching the preferred position (NY law, NY courts).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.
Deterministic check confirms the governing law falls within the accepted set; no arbitration seat or foreign venue appears in the cited text.

Shortfalls versus the preferred wording (venue stated as the State of New York generally rather than exclusively New York County, and no express exclusivity) are properly noted in the rationale rather than flagged as deviations, and the jury-trial waiver and limitations period are correctly treated as outside this rule.
